what_this_is: A verifiable record of the held-out gate evaluation that does not expose which items were routed. The decision vector is the per-item fire/no-fire bit in ascending item-id order. Its sha256 is published so that anyone who obtains the held-out partition under the leaderboard protocol can recompute the vector and confirm it matches, without us releasing the partition or the per-item mapping.
how_to_verify: Run code/router/gate_infer.py against the held-out partition with data/router/gate_frozen.json. The script prints the decision-vector sha256. If it matches the value above, the frozen model reproduced the reported evaluation exactly.
